info.name: SystemDisplayPlugin
info.description:
Postman collection for SystemDisplayPlugin — stage-2 mapper that reshapes ConvoScribe / ORScribe JSON onto a target view schema. It does not regenerate clinical content.

Auth is currently disabled. Send requests with no X-API-Key.

**Setup**
1. Import this collection.
2. Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:8031).
3. Run **Reshape — SOAP + Vital Signs + Measurement (full)** for the three chart views in one call.

request.description: Database / Redis / OpenAI health. No API key required.

request.description:
Full ReshapeRequest body. Prefer views[] / view_ids[]; aliases view_decoder / view_id still work and may be mixed.

Required:
- stage1_output — ConvoScribe/ORScribe JSON (example is a full ConvoScribe /analyze response)
- context — appointment | ward_round | operating_room | procedure | telehealth | other
- purpose — summary | soap_note | clinical_document | timeline | checklist_verification | full_transcript_review
- views and/or view_ids (at least one)

Response: { results: [{ view_id, data, warnings }] }. 422 only if no view succeeds.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Same reshape contract, but uses a stored decoder. Run **Register decoder** first. Body still includes full stage1_output, context, purpose, and view_id.
Full reshape body for an ORScribe-style timeline + checklist payload (context=operating_room, purpose=timeline).

request.description:
Full single-call example that populates all three chart views from one stage1_output:
- soap_note (SOAP Note)
- vital_signs (Vital Signs — view 1)
- measurement (Measurement — view 2)

The body includes the complete inline `views` definitions (every field, source_path, and transform) plus a ConvoScribe-style payload with flattened SOAP fields, `vitals`, and `measurements`.

Equivalent stored-decoder call after startup seed: `view_ids: ["soap_note", "vital_signs", "measurement"]` (omit `views`).

ConvoScribe/ORScribe do not yet emit structured vitals/measurements; those objects are included here so the mapping succeeds. SOAP decoder paths are top-level subjective/objective/assessment/plan (also duplicated under summary for a realistic /analyze envelope).

response.name: 200 OK — three views
